You may use the website and preview for lawful personal evaluation and self-reflection. The preview may change, be interrupted, or be withdrawn as the product develops. Features described as planned or coming soon are product intentions, not commitments to a specific release date or functionality.

Inputs exist only in the memory of the open app page. Refreshing, closing, or leaving the app clears them. There is no backup or recovery service. Do not use this preview as your only record of important information. Our privacy policy explains the current implementation and website-delivery practices.

Intend is a general self-reflection tool. It does not provide medical, psychological, diagnostic, treatment, or emergency services.
